_readme: Live fare config for MeterSmart. Edit + redeploy to change rates without an app update. IMPORTANT: bump 'version' by 1 on every change, otherwise clients ignore the file. Keep it in sync with DEFAULT_RATES in index.html.
source: Karnataka Transport Dept. / BMTC auto tariff

complaint._note: Leave blank to let the user pick the recipient. Fill in only with an address/number you have verified as current.
